title: Stews Localisation
description: Localisation resource pack for Stews - Hunger Rebalanced. Does nothing on it's own
body:
This resource pack adds Japanese localisations for the [Stews - Hunger Rebalanced](https://modrinth.com/datapack/stews-rebalanced) datapack. The datapack works just fine without this resource pack if you use it in English.

このリーソースパックは、[Stews - Hunger Rebalanced](https://modrinth.com/datapack/stews-rebalanced) を日本語に翻訳します。

Feel free to give feedback on these translations [here](https://github.com/tjb3171/stews-rebalanced/issues). If you speak another language and want to translate, feel free to let me know :)

日本語がおかしいっと思ったら、[ここ](https://github.com/tjb3171/stews-rebalanced/issues)の課題管理システムを使用して教えてください :D
